question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Connect
solution:
The correct answer is **Detach.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Connect** means to join or be joined with something else. 

 
 
• **Example:* ****I have to **connect** my printer to your computer.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Detach** means to separate or remove something from something else that it is connected to.
 
 
• **Example: ***You can **detach** the hood if you prefer the coat without it*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of the given word **'connect'** is **'detach.' **

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
